# Nondisclosure schedule: project descriptions

This schedule describes information covered by a draft nondisclosure agreement. The projects are identified by their internal titles.

- Copper Horizon: a folding display stand with replaceable hinges.
- Silver Orchard: a collection of colour samples for a proposed exhibition.
- Night Compass: a draft instruction booklet explaining assembly and packing.

Access to the materials is permitted only to evaluate a possible licence. The recipient must not distribute the drawings or use them to commission a competing prototype. The draft agreement does not require either side to enter a later supply contract.

The title Copper Horizon must appear on the cover of each drawing set so that versions can be distinguished. Samples from Silver Orchard may be viewed only at the discloser's premises. Night Compass remains unpublished and must not be copied.

An evaluation period of forty-five days is proposed. The illustrative licence fee is GBP 2,500, and the suggested start date is 8 January 2027. Section 5.3 concerns return of the drawings, while article 9 concerns permitted disclosures.

The signature blocks are left blank in this circulation copy and will be completed when the agreement is signed.
